goals.statement: Connect with colleagues and former classmates on LinkedIn to see what they are up to.

supported_parts: 连接同事与同学的动作
support.label: direct
support.rationale: 原句明确列出在 LinkedIn 上做的事包括 networking、连接同事与过去同学并查看其近况，主体、对象与目的一致。

goals.statement: Run marketing on LinkedIn to obtain exposure that is far better than Google Ads, Facebook or other channels in the stakeholder's field.
conditions: in the stakeholder's field, where LinkedIn exposure is judged better than other channels

supported_parts: 曝光优于其他渠道的判断
support.label: direct
support.rationale: 原文明确说‘We do a lot of marketing’并把 LinkedIn 的曝光与 Google ads、Facebook 等渠道作比较，认定前者更好；主体、渠道与结果均保留。

goals.statement: Recruit through LinkedIn to source many candidates at a cost that is fairly low compared with competitors.
conditions: exception: in the small Laravel community, posting on Lara Jobs yields better candidates than LinkedIn

support.label: direct
support.rationale: 原句明确说通过 LinkedIn 大量招聘、来源广且相对竞争者成本低；T015 的 Laravel/Lara Jobs 例外已作为条件保留，不改变一般招聘目标。

goals.statement: Browse job openings for himself on LinkedIn and check salary ranges from time to time.
conditions: occasionally, when he feels like poking around

support.label: direct
support.rationale: 原句‘looking for jobs for myself ... see what some of the salary ranges’表达查看外部机会与薪资范围的意愿，保留‘sometimes / nice to’的弱强度。

goals.statement: Check community events posted on LinkedIn when he has the availability and bandwidth, since email alone makes it impossible to keep up.
conditions: emails arrive in a firehose, so he cannot keep up otherwise

support.label: direct
support.rationale: 原句说明在有空闲与带宽时会上 LinkedIn 查看社区活动，并给出邮件太多无法兼顾的理由；条件与理由均保留。

goals.statement: Maintain a credible LinkedIn profile with credentials, degrees and a photo matching his real appearance, so that clients can confirm he is genuine and not a scammer.
conditions: for clients and people who receive his emails

support.label: direct
support.rationale: 原句明确把资料页当作向客户示意身份与资历、供人核验其非诈骗的资源，属维持型目标；照片与本人一致等细节保留。

goals.statement: Use LinkedIn's easy, user-friendly posting tools, including paid recommendations, to put broad-based marketing in front of a targeted audience.
conditions: he already runs marketing on LinkedIn

inference.reason: 受访者已明确在 LinkedIn 上大量做营销（G002），并评价发帖与推荐工具‘very easy and user friendly’、可‘pretty targeted’；由此推断其选择这些工具作为投放方式，而非仅作泛泛评价。
assumptions: 易用与可定向是该受访者持续使用这些工具的实际理由

reasoning_steps: 原文正面评价发帖与推荐工具
推断以其作为实现方式
support.label: inferred
support.rationale: 原文只陈述工具易用、适合广泛而有针对性的营销，未直接说‘我要用这些工具’；结合其持续营销的正向依据可推断方式选择，故记 inferred。

goals.statement: Prefer LinkedIn Learning for quick deep dives into a technology stack or a marketing practice, because its quality exceeds YouTube and similar resources.
conditions: when he wants a quick deep dive

supported_parts: 用于快速深入了解技术栈或营销做法
质量优于 YouTube 的偏好理由
support.label: direct
support.rationale: 原句‘I did like ... one of the better places to go ... quality would definitely exceed ... YouTube’直接表达对 e-learning 内容的偏好及质量理由；属偏好型目标，未升级为强制。

goals.statement: Publish marketing or awareness posts about events such as conferences, as the company and/or personal profile, with images, videos or other visual additions.
conditions: typically when something interesting happens at a conference
may post as the company profile, his personal profile, or both

support.label: direct
support.rationale: 原文以‘Typically what we'll do is ... post something about it’描述会议现场发营销/曝光帖的固定做法，并说明公司/个人主页切换与图片视频等做法；方式与情境保留。

goals.statement: Schedule posts for about 9 AM the next morning when people first arrive at the office, instead of posting in the evening, to get more impressions.
conditions: posting in the evening is judged to get fewer impressions

support.label: direct
support.rationale: 原文明确说要改为次日上午 9 点定时发布、晚上发布曝光更少；时间、理由与预期结果一致。

goals.statement: Gain interactions once a post is on the feed and, hopefully, eventually win some business.
conditions: outcome is hoped for, not guaranteed

support.label: direct
support.rationale: 原句说发布后会开始获得互动，并‘hopefully, eventually win some business’；保留希望强度，未写成承诺或指标。

goals.statement: Before connecting with a new prospect, search the person's profile and review the background for common threads, and avoid cold calls or cold connection requests.
conditions: usually only connects with people he knows
example prospect: a C-level person at a company he wants to sell to

support.label: direct
support.rationale: 原文明确说明只联系认识的人、不做 cold call/cold add；对目标公司的 C-level 会先搜索资料、看背景找共同点再决定是否添加。动作、对象与否定均保留。

goals.statement: Have LinkedIn provide more automated support for content development so that a smaller marketing team is needed.

support.label: direct
support.rationale: 原文在被问及希望增加或修改什么时明确回答内容开发支持、希望更多自动化，以减少对大型营销团队的需要；建议强度保留。

goals.statement: Be able to post professional-looking content without six rounds of review or going through the whole marketing-funnel approval process.
conditions: design is at a premium and always takes a while

supported_parts: 免去六轮评审与营销漏斗
support.label: direct
support.rationale: 原文明确希望不必被评审 6 次、不必走完整营销漏斗就能发布专业外观的内容，并说明设计耗时是原因；强度与条件保留。

refinement_groups.rationale: 发布内容并在早高峰定时，看起来共同构成获得互动的操作组合；但原文没有给出内容质量、受众规模与转化条件，不能声称整组已足以实现获得互动与业务。
assumptions: 把发布与定时视为同一流程中互补的两个子目标

checks.scenario: 受访者在会议现场写好一条营销帖，并定时到次日 9 点人群上线时发布。
checks.rationale: 发布使内容进入 feed，定时提升曝光；两者共同构成获得互动的前置条件。

checks.scenario: 内容与目标受众无关、账号粉丝很少，或只发布而不回应评论时，即使按早高峰定时也未必获得互动或业务。
checks.rationale: 原文未给出内容质量、受众规模与互动转化条件，且有其他目标（G013/G014）涉及内容制作，故整组不能成立为充分精化。

已检查 G013（内容开发自动化支持）与 G014（免多轮评审发布专业内容）之间是否存在实现方式或贡献联系：原文只并列提出两项期望，未说明自动化能减少评审轮次，故未建立联系。
已检查 G006（可信的专业资料页）是否有助于 G011（获得互动与业务）：原文只说明向客户传递可信度，未说明它带来互动或成交，故未建立联系。
已检查 G012（先查背景再加人）与 G001（与同事、同学联系）之间的联系：两者对象不同（陌生目标客户 vs 熟人），原文未说明前者服务于后者，故未建立联系。
已检查 G008（LinkedIn Learning 快速深入）与其他目标的联系：原文未说明它服务于营销、招聘或职业发展；且 T005 明确否认 LinkedIn 对职业发展起作用，故无联系依据。
受访者把广告与界面杂乱列为最大困扰（T017），但未提出明确的改动要求；是否应据此建立‘减少广告/无关内容干扰’的目标，待确认。
GR1 缺少内容质量、受众规模与互动转化条件的依据，也未把 G013/G014（专业内容制作）纳入为共同前提，尚不能成立。
